component.name: MenuPanel
component.script:
sub init_x() m.label = m.top.findNode("title") m.list = m.top.findNode("list") m.list.observeField("itemSelected", "onSelected") m.top.observeField("focusedChild", "onFocusedChild") m.top.visible = false if m.global.hasField("accent") and m.global.accent <> invalid and m.global.accent <> "" then m.top.findNode("bar").color = m.global.accent end sub sub init() try init_x() catch e reportCrash("MenuPanel.init", e) end try end sub
sub onTitle_x() m.label.text = m.top.title end sub sub onTitle() try onTitle_x() catch e reportCrash("MenuPanel.onTitle", e) end try end sub
sub onItems_x() root = CreateObject("roSGNode", "ContentNode") for each it in m.top.items c = root.createChild("ContentNode") c.title = it end for m.list.content = root idx = m.top.startIndex if idx > 0 and idx < m.top.items.Count() then m.list.jumpToItem = idx end sub sub onItems() try onItems_x() catch e reportCrash("MenuPanel.onItems", e) end try end sub
sub onFocusedChild_x() if m.top.hasFocus() then m.list.setFocus(true) end sub sub onFocusedChild() try onFocusedChild_x() catch e reportCrash("MenuPanel.onFocusedChild", e) end try end sub
sub onSelected_x() m.top.selected = m.list.itemSelected end sub sub onSelected() try onSelected_x() catch e reportCrash("MenuPanel.onSelected", e) end try end sub
function onKeyEvent_x(key as string, press as boolean) as boolean if not press then return false if key = "back" or key = "options" or key = "left" m.top.cancelled = true return true end if ' não deixar as teclas escaparem para o vídeo por baixo return key = "right" or key = "play" or key = "fastforward" or key = "rewind" end function function onKeyEvent(key as string, press as boolean) as boolean handled = false try handled = onKeyEvent_x(key, press) catch e reportCrash("MenuPanel.onKeyEvent", e) end try return handled end function
